title: WV Congress candidates' millions in assets include big tech, fossil fuel investments
description: Voters have focused on affordability throughout the 2026 election cycle, calling for lowering the cost of living. With household expenses potentially shaping ballot results amid rising inflation and energy costs, West Virginia’s congressional candidates have significantly more financial assets to draw from than the state’s electorate at large. Many of the congressional candidates on ballots across West Virginia reported financial assets valued at hundreds of thousands of dollars or more, according to a Gazette-Mail review of federally required candidate financial disclosures. The candidates are Sen. Shelley Moore Capito, Rep. Carol Miller, Rep. Riley Moore, Rachel Fetty Anderson, S. Marshall Wilson, Vince George, Belinda Fox-Spencer and Ace Parsi.

title: Italian farmer planted mysterious seeds found in attic, discovered ancient biblical wheat with seven ears on one stalk that could help crops survive drought and climate change
description: In a remarkable find, Claudio Grossi, an Italian farmer, unearthed an ancient wheat variety known as Triticum turgidum, which is believed to be over a century old. This heritage wheat demonstrated impressive drought resistance compared to its modern counterparts. Experts highlight the significance of genetic diversity in crops to combat climate change impacts, further prompting research into the nutritional upsides and drawbacks of this time-honored grain in modern agriculture.
